product_metadata.title: ETwinCoo All-Purpose Suction Cups Hooks [Combo Set] Reliable Strongest Window Suction Cups with Hooks (2 Large, 4 Medium, 6 Small), 12 Pack
features: ▲MULTI SIZE DESIGN-- These powerful combo set suction cups for glass includes three sizes, each size of suction cup hooks is rated to hold up to 2lbs (30mm), 3lbs (45mm), 7lbs (60mm), can meet your daily uses and replacement.

▲POWERFUL- HOLD-- These window suction cups are made of waterproof and temperature resistant PVC meterial, round strip design make them soft and adhere to the smooth surface more firmly. These window suction cups with stainless steel hooks would not rusty even in wet.

▲DETACHABLE & REUSABLE-- The metal hooks and suction cups are detachable and can also be used separately. The suction cup hooks for windows is simply pull up on the release tab to break the suction without any traces left like sticky residue or stains.

▲EASY TO INSTALL-- Include 2 large, 4 medium, 6 small suction cups. Don't need tools or drilling, simply clean your surface, slightly wet it with a damp rag, apply the suction cup, and firmly push to activate suction makes.

▲ALL-PURPOSE-- These clear suction cup hooks are almost invisible and can blend in any decoration style, will not yellow or lose adhesion over time. Great for hanging wreaths, utensils, towels, tools and multi-size decorations in windows, on smooth glass, mirrors, tile or any other clean, slick, non-porous surface.
